# Routing Protocol Messages

## OSPF neighbor change

%OSPF-5-ADJCHG: Process 1, Nbr 10.0.0.2 on GigabitEthernet0/2 from FULL to DOWN, Neighbor Down: Dead timer expired

Explanation: This sample message means the neighbor relationship changed state. A dead timer expiry points to missed hello packets, which can come from packet loss, interface problems, mismatched timers, or an overloaded peer.

Recommended Action: Compare both sides of the adjacency, verify hello and dead timers, inspect link quality, and check whether routing updates stopped at the same time.
